theorems.name: Submission.codim1_ovr_embedded_submanifold_local
theorems.statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ r → (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧ IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (M ∩ O)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M ∧ ∀ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (M ∩ O) ∧ ∀ w ∈ M ∩ O, tangentSpace (M ∩ O) w = tangentSpace M w
